init_hook: echo '   devbox run setup      install deps + create backend/.env   (run once)'
echo '   devbox services up    DB (docker) + backend :3000 + frontend :5173, with TUI'
echo '                         restart <name> / logs / health; add -b to background'
echo '   devbox run db:reset   WIPE the DB volume + fresh Postgres   (stop services first)'
echo '   devbox run migrate    (re)create constraint tables          (DB must be up)'

setup: echo '✅ deps installed, backend/.env ready. Start with: devbox services up'
db:reset: docker compose --env-file backend/.env -p event-modeler -f backend/docker-compose.yml down -v
docker compose --env-file backend/.env -p event-modeler -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait
echo '🧨 DB volume wiped — fresh Postgres on :5432. Backend re-migrates on start (or: devbox run migrate).'
